Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.timeline

Interface Timelined

All Superinterfaces:
BoundedTag
All Known Implementing Classes:
ButtonTag, DefineButton2Tag, DefineButtonTag, DefineSpriteTag, DefineVideoStreamTag, SWF
public interface Timelined extends BoundedTag
Represents an object which can be created timeline from. It has list of tags which can be listed and/or modified.

JPEXS
